proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2530 eṣa/eta gives Nepali yo, eastern i/e, Hindi yah and Punjabi e/eh. The selected proximal demonstratives fit this historical paradigm; the survey’s singular/plural use is retained, and compounds or relative-pronoun j-forms are not collapsed into it.
